topic.title: Property is the new rishta
topic.claim: Single women are now buying homes purely as investment, not waiting for a husband's income or sanction, and I think homeownership just stopped being proof you got married and became proof you didn't have to wait.
topic.behaviour: Women now make up close to a third of India's homebuyer base, nearly a third of women buyers purchasing purely as an investment rather than for marriage or family use, most states now offering stamp-duty discounts for property registered in a woman's name, trend strongest in Bengaluru, Pune and Hyderabad.
topic.mechanism: Delayed marriage and rising incomes mean the biggest financial decision of a young woman's life no longer needs a man's name on it or a family's sanction.
topic.group: single, career-established women in their late 20s to 40s in metro cities
real_details: women make up close to a third of India's homebuyer base in 2026
nearly a third of women buyers are purchasing purely as an investment rather than for marriage or family use
most states now offer stamp-duty discounts for property registered in a woman's name
trend is strongest in Bengaluru, Pune and Hyderabad
topic.news_peg: 2026 industry homebuyer data on single women homebuyers, reported October 2026
topic.why_now: multiple 2026 datasets on this converged and were reported this month

score.why: Property and authority shifting to whoever owns it is her territory; this just puts a 2026 name on it without repeating the arranged-marriage angle.
